name: wordpress
description: WordPress site administration over the REST API — posts, pages, media, taxonomies, comments, users and SEO — against a PRODUCTION site. Credentials come from the macOS login Keychain via a Nix-installed launcher, never from this repo.

launcher.title: WordPress MCP launcher
launcher.description: Command that starts a stdio WordPress MCP server that finds its own site URL and credentials, split on spaces (e.g. `nix-mcp-wordpress` on the kattakath fleet). Falls back to $WORDPRESS_MCP_COMMAND; with neither, the server does not start and says why.
